title: The Unsaid Language
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Zephyrine Pemberton, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
